seo.title: Work — Innogenio
seo.description: Selected Innogenio case studies: ERP rollouts live in twelve weeks, AI automation cutting loan processing to minutes, and analytics platforms serving millions of orders.

hero.lead: A selection of what we've shipped with our clients — from plant-floor ERP to production AI, measured in outcomes, not slides.

groups.intro: Six engagements, end-to-end — what we built and what it changed.

items.title: Meridian Manufacturing

items.title: NovaPay

items.title: Halo Retail

items.title: Corevance
items.body: ERP workflows automated without breaking a single integration — finance now closes the quarter in four days, not eleven.

items.title: Kepler Labs
items.body: Design and engineering under one roof shipped v2 two months ahead of the board's deadline.

items.title: Helixon
items.body: A data pipeline rebuilt in nine weeks — deploy frequency tripled and on-call pages dropped to nearly zero.
